component.name: Invisible Deck Helper
component.summary: Practice aid for the Invisible Deck card trick

description.p: Invisible Deck Helper deals you one card at a time so you can rehearse the Invisible Deck. A spectator names a card, you spread the deck and the named card is the only one face up — this shows you the card, and optionally the card glued to its back, so you can check yourself.

ul.li: Shows a single random card by default
Speaks the card aloud with Piper (English, Great Britain — Alan, medium quality)
An "Invisible Deck pair" toggle, off by default, reveals and announces the partner card
Space or Enter deals the next card

description.p: With the pair toggle off it says just the card ("Queen of Hearts"); with it on it says "Queen of Hearts pairs with Ace of Spades". Speech is generated locally — nothing is sent to any service.
The pairings follow the published arrangement: hearts pair with spades and diamonds with clubs, each pair totals thirteen, and kings pair with kings.

Adds an Inno Setup installer for Windows alongside the portable ZIP: per-user by default so there is no UAC prompt, with Start Menu entries, an optional desktop shortcut and a proper uninstaller in Add or Remove Programs. Both packages contain the same files.

Runs on Windows 11 as well as Linux. Speech keeps using Piper with the English (Great Britain) Alan medium voice: on Windows the app ships an embedded Python beside the exe, and plays audio through winmm instead of PulseAudio. Adds a --speech-info report that lists every path searched when speech cannot be found.
Adds a "Mute speech" tickbox to silence the voice for a session without losing the spoken phrase on screen, plus an IDH_MUTE=1 environment override for starting silent.
Adds spoken output using Piper with the English (Great Britain) Alan medium voice: the card alone by default, or "card pairs with card" when the Invisible Deck pair toggle is on.
First release: one card at a time with an optional Invisible Deck pair reveal.
